title:
Type representing the timed value of failure mode feedback.

The `FailureModeFeedbackTimedValue` type is used to capture feedback related to a failure mode along with
the associated timing and additional information. This type includes the feedback score, the engineer
who provided the feedback, and the comment explaining the feedback.
name: FailureModeFeedbackTimedValue
